# PayBits

> Smart UPI Payment Splitter & QR Generator for Indian digital payments.

PayBits (https://paybits.vercel.app/) is a 100% client-side web utility that divides large Indian UPI (Unified Payments Interface) bills into customizable, smaller chunks (such as under ₹2,000). For each split chunk, PayBits generates a high-definition dynamic QR code, 1-tap mobile app launchers for Google Pay, PhonePe, and Paytm, and an itemized breakdown shareable directly to WhatsApp.

## Key Capabilities

- **Intelligent Payment Splitting**: Automatically divides any total amount into equal chunks under a configurable cap (default: ₹2,000) plus any remainder.
- **Instant Dynamic QR Codes**: Generates standard UPI QR codes locally in the browser following NPCI specifications (`upi://pay?pa=...&pn=...&am=...&cu=INR`).
- **1-Tap UPI App Launchers**: Deep links to launch installed UPI apps directly on mobile devices (Google Pay, PhonePe, Paytm, BHIM, Cred, and universal UPI intent).
- **100% Client-Side Privacy**: Operates entirely in the browser with zero tracking, zero server-side storage, and zero database logging. No financial credentials or UPI IDs are ever transmitted over the network.
- **Live Progress Tracking**: Interactive checklist to mark chunks as paid, view completion percentage, and celebrate when the bill is fully cleared.
- **WhatsApp Receipts**: 1-click generation of formatted breakdown messages with payment links for easy sharing with payees or groups.
- **Shareable Deep Links**: URL query parameters (`?amount=5000&vpa=receiver@upi&name=Merchant`) allow sharing pre-filled bills.

## Target Audience & Geographic Scope

- **Region**: India (IN)
- **Currency**: Indian Rupee (INR / ₹)
- **Ecosystem**: Unified Payments Interface (UPI) managed by the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI).
